rows.notes: The document is explicitly labelled a Review Article; it contains no own experiment, survey, data or model runs. It describes drip irrigation types, components, history, advantages and disadvantages, citing other work (e.g. refs 2, 6-8, 10, 27, 50). Statements that drip delivers water slowly to the root zone and reduces evaporation are narrative assertions drawn from the literature, not the study's own results. The Conclusion refers to yield, WUE and benefit-cost findings that are not reported anywhere in the text and appear borrowed from cited banana drip-fertigation studies.

notes: Study is a narrative review (self-described, with acknowledgement calling it a review paper) with no methods, data, tables of results or statistics of its own; only Table 2 (from Rainbird International 1980) and figures of schematic/photographs. Q1 is 'no', so all other questions are 'no'.
